# SOP-P3-L3-01 Line startup - Machining line

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P3, line P3-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L3-SB01, EQ-P3-L3-CN02, EQ-P3-L3-HP03  
Related documents: ECN-2026-016, MM-P3-L3-CN02, MM-P3-L3-CN02-S1

1. Purpose
   - Provide required actions to start the machining line and verify safe readiness of EQ-P3-L3-SB01, EQ-P3-L3-CN02, and EQ-P3-L3-HP03.

2. Preconditions
   - Line power available and locked in accordance with facility lockout procedures.
   - Maintenance tasks from ECN-2026-016 completed and signed off.
   - Preventive maintenance on EQ-P3-L3-CN02 verified per MM-P3-L3-CN02 and MM-P3-L3-CN02-S1.

3. PPE
   - Safety glasses, hearing protection, cut-resistant gloves, steel-toe footwear, and face shield as required for machining operations.

4. Lubrication check
   - Confirm lubricant installed on EQ-P3-L3-CN02 matches part specification: The lubricant part number for Machining CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P3-L3-CN02) is CFW-LUB-611.

5. Mechanical torque verification
   - Verify main ram bolt on EQ-P3-L3-HP03 has been torqued to the required value: The main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 1600 N·m.

6. Machine power-up sequence
   - Release local lockouts and follow machine control startup prompts for EQ-P3-L3-SB01, EQ-P3-L3-CN02, then EQ-P3-L3-HP03.
   - Observe emergency stop logic and verify audible/visual alarms function.

7. Functional checks
   - Perform axis homing and tool detection on EQ-P3-L3-CN02.
   - Run single-stroke test on EQ-P3-L3-HP03 with guard in place to confirm motion and interlocks.

8. Quality and safety verification
   - Confirm first-part dimensions and clamping integrity.
   - Verify guarding and light curtains are operational.

9. Abnormal conditions
   - If alarms persist or torque/lubricant discrepant, secure equipment and notify maintenance per ECN-2026-016.

10. Sign-off
   - Operator prints name, signs, and records time. Supervisor verifies steps and initials completion.
